note: The record rests on one official post (the Governor's release of 7 May 2026, which confirms signing and the core duties) and a secondary article, so level C is right. The signing date 31 Mar 2026 is inferred from the article's 1 Apr 2026 update ('yesterday'), and the quote does not itself show the year; one secondary tracker found by search gives 1 Apr 2026, so the day is not certain. The effective date of 1 Jan 2027 is confirmed by several secondary sources found by search, none official. I found no chapter number or amendment. A person could provide the enrolled bill.
